scoring_formula: The verifier emits 75 boolean checks, first reports three normalized bucket totals, then computes runtime reward as the canonical equal mean of those already-normalized bucket totals: total_static_check_score, total_reward_hacking_check_score, and total_partial_oracle_check_score. Each check is equal-weight within its own bucket; raw bucket sizes do not change the final reward. verifier_type=hybrid: if the LLM judge is unavailable or unparseable the verifier writes invalid_evaluation=true and does not treat a deterministic-only mean as a comparable reward. An uncaught verifier exception takes the same route.
content_share_target: >=0.60. Under the canonical equal-bucket runtime formula, content is 2 of 3 buckets (deterministic reward_hacking plus partial_oracle LLM), i.e. 66.7%.
check_weighting_note: Each check is equal-weight within its bucket; runtime reward is the equal mean of static, deterministic reward_hacking, and partial_oracle bucket scores. The deterministic content bucket includes finished-row quality checks requiring quote grounding, recomputed tightness, substantive notes, grounded paraphrases, and source-window classification footprints.
freebie_floor_measured: Historical offline discrimination metadata is retained for reference only; it predates the bucket aggregation and is not a runtime threshold.
anti_padding: is_substantive_obligation drops heading/TOC/quote-slice/no-verb paraphrases. Shape alone confers no credit; grounding thresholds count grounded rows.
grounding_coverage: Every substantive row is full-quote-checked against its jurisdiction text. A second check requires the quote to sit in the claim's locator/focus neighbourhood and rejects near-duplicate quotes within the same jurisdiction/theme.
judged_input_coverage: The judged layer sees pinned instrument excerpts, atlas/briefing/ledger excerpts, and the full required 180-row matrix cohort with per-cell truncation rather than a 120-row sample.

judge_config.provider_resolution: First key present among GRADER_API_KEY, WANDB_API_KEY, FIREWORKS_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, MOONSHOT_API_KEY. No key is stored in task files.
judge_config.model_id: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (W&B catalog + trainer vision-verifier template default). Fallbacks: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash, zai-org/GLM-5.2, openai/gpt-oss-120b, then moonshotai/Kimi-K2.6 / kimi-k2.6.
judge_config.request_rules: Do NOT send temperature. response_format json_object for JSON-based judging. thinking disabled only on bare kimi-* Moonshot fallback ids.
judge_config.judge_independence: Candidate order leads with Qwen so the model under test does not grade its own output; Kimi ids remain as last-resort fallbacks.
judge_config.audit: llm_status.json records grader key, base url, judge model, temperature=omitted, and judged_checks_scored.

measured_discrimination: Canonical equal-bucket reward plus finished-row quality checks are intended to separate broad-but-shallow rows from rows whose quote, score, note, and classification evidence agree. Embedded execution evidence should be reverified with this manifest before gap use.
